Aisha (CEO): Quick exec update — short and actionable.

- Focus this week: capacity headroom, pricing pilot, Dedicated GA timeline, SLA targets.
- Metrics snapshot: p50 latency ~120ms, p95 ~450ms on hosted; Dedicated engineering target: p95 <250ms for baseline workloads.
- Pricing pilot: running with 3 early customers next week to test unit economics and volume discounts.
- Ops: temporarily tighten autoscale burst to preserve reserved capacity for Dedicated commitments.
- Action: leads, please review the attached deck and confirm any blockers by EOD Wed. Deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-redwood-exec-deck

Jordan (Finance): I'll run sensitivity w/ 3 pilot outcomes and post numbers by Thu AM. Early estimate: 6-8% ARR delta if discounts applied.

Leah (Customer Success): Heads up — flagged 2 customers worried about latency; recommend reaching out to top 10 accounts preemptively.

Aisha (CEO): Good catch, Leah. Please draft outreach template; include fallback plan (upgrade to Dedicated with promo). I'll approve.

Aisha (CEO): Final note — hold new marketplace listings until pricing pilot completes and we confirm SLA language. Thanks team. :pray:
